Name: Tappuah in Ephraim
ModernLocation: Tell Abu Zarad, on the Ephraim-Manasseh border
Description: A town on the border between Ephraim and Manasseh, named in Joshua's allotment and in the list of kings defeated by Israel; distinct from the Tappuah of Judah's lowland.
BiblicalSignificance: Tappuah in Ephraim stood on the tribal border, a former Canaanite royal city taken into the allotments.
